newsitem.title: CANADA: Agrium to buy US$400 mln of Viridian debt.
newsitem.headline: Agrium to buy US$400 mln of Viridian debt.

text.p: Fertilizer giant Agrium Inc said on Thursday it had offered to buy about US$400 million in outstanding debt of Viridian Inc.
Viridian shareholders will vote to amalgamate with Agrium at a December 10, 1996 meeting, Agrium said.
The offer is for all outstanding Viridian 9 3/4 percent notes due 2003; 11 percent notes due 2004, and 10 1/2 percent debentures due 2014, Agrium said.
The offer will expire at 2400 EST/0500 GMT unless extended. The purchase price for each security will be set at 1400 EST on December 17, 1996, Agrium said.
Agrium said the offer is conditioned upon completion of the amalgamation of Agrium and Viridian, but is not a condition to the completion of the merger.
